issues.display_title: Issue #114: Footer: replace hardcoded version and index sync date with build commit and real last update
issues.main_description_html:
Description

The footer line v2.4 · Last index sync: 2026‑05‑21 (src/components/site-footer.tsx:62) is hardcoded:

  • The date is the template's first-commit date. It has never changed.
  • v2.4 has no source; package.json is 0.1.0.

Proposal

  • Build commit: inline the short git SHA at build time through next.config.ts env, and show it as Build <sha> (unknown outside a git checkout).
  • Last index sync: fetch it from the new backend GET /v1/photographers/last-updated, which is MAX updated_at of listed photographers.
    • It renders inside <Suspense> so the footer fetch never blocks the page.
    • If the request fails, the sync part is hidden. No fake date is shown.

Acceptance

  • The footer shows the commit that was built and the real last data change.
  • No hardcoded dates remain in the footer.
  • Pages render normally when the backend endpoint is down or not deployed yet.

Responsiveness Verified at 375px mobile viewport without horizontal overflow
Test Coverage White Box, Gray Box, Black Box, Negative & Stress Testing
Final Verdict Passed

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification

  • Build Commit Short SHA: Implemented execSync("git rev-parse --short HEAD") in next.config.ts passed via env.BUILD_COMMIT and surfaced as Build {process.env.BUILD_COMMIT || "unknown"} in src/components/site-footer.tsx.
  • Backend Last Updated Endpoint Scoping: Added getLastIndexUpdate() in src/data/layer/photographers.ts fetching GET /v1/photographers/last-updated with Next.js ISR revalidation { next: { revalidate: 3600 } }. It uses standard fetch instead of DataRequest so static routes remain static without turning dynamic.
  • Graceful Failure Isolation: When backend returns 404 or fails, getLastIndexUpdate() catches and returns null. IndexSync returns null so no broken placeholders (null / undefined) or fake dates are displayed.
  • Legacy Artifact Removal: Confirmed completely clean removal of v2.4 and template hardcoded date 2026-05-21.

issues.display_title: Issue #111: Find Photographers: list search only filters the map's visible set, and stays empty until the slow basemap loads
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by Developer

video-111-map-list-search.mp4

Problem

Client feedback on Find Photographers (/find-google-trusted-photographers):

why the search does not work ?

The screenshots show the side list's "Search this list…" box with GoThru, then Abe. Both give "0 photographers visible" and "Pan the map", while the map shows dozens of markers.

The box works as built. It reads as broken for two reasons, both measured on production on 2026-10-09.

1. It only filters the photographers the map currently reports as visible. sortedList in src/components/map-page.tsx:220-232 is the socket cache ∩ visibleSlugs from the embed's MAP_PHOTOGRAPHERS_MARKERS_VISIBLE, then filtered by name city country. At the default world view the embed reports 26 of 199 photographers.

  • abe: the only match in the directory is Isabelle Billerey – Jacques Lauber (ibjl, Sierre, Switzerland), who is not among those 26, so it returns 0. After zooming the map to Sierre, the list holds 1 and abe finds her.
  • GoThru: no photographer has that name. Every entry point gives 0, but the UI says nothing about why.

2. For a first-time visitor the list stays empty for over a minute. The embed posts MAP_LOADED from maplibre's load and MAP_PHOTOGRAPHERS_MARKERS_VISIBLE from idle, and both wait for the basemap tiles. Those come from map-embed-orig.gothru.co:

  • At zoom 2 a tile is 550–690 KB gzipped, served at about 40–95 KB/s even on an nginx cache HIT, so 5–17 s per tile. From the same machine, Cloudflare downloads at 4.6 MB/s.
  • In a fresh browser context, 4 zoom-2 tiles were still pending at 25 s. There was no MAP_LOADED and no visible-markers post, the list stayed at 0, and every search gave 0.
  • In a browser with the tiles cached, the list shows 26 within about 10 s.
  • map-page.tsx and mapPostsMessage.tsx haven't changed since 2026-09-04, so this is not a frontend regression.

Scope (frontend)

  1. Typing searches the whole directory, not the map's view.
    • When the box has text, fetch matches with the existing getPhotographersV2({ search }) (src/data/layer/photographers.ts). /v2/photographers/users?search= already matches photographer names: abe → Isabelle Billerey, isabelle → same, gothru → none.
    • Debounce it, and drop stale responses like #108's city search does.
    • Show those results in the side list, independent of visibleSlugs.
    • With an empty box, keep today's list (photographers in view).
  2. No match. Show No photographers named "". If the query looks like a place, point to the "Find a specific location…" box, because ?search= doesn't match cities (sierre → 0, but the location search finds Sierre).
  3. Copy. Make the placeholder say what it searches, e.g. "Search photographers by name…". While the map hasn't reported anything yet, replace "Pan the map" with a loading state instead of an instruction.
  4. Optional: clicking a search result could fly the map to that photographer, posting MAP_RECV_LOCATION with their city, the same as picking a location.

Out of scope: tile server (infra)

The tile host's throughput is what keeps the list empty on a first visit, and it also makes the map slow for everyone. Putting map-embed-orig.gothru.co/data/openmaptiles/* behind a CDN, or raising its bandwidth, fixes that at the source. The embed (gothru-maps-frontend) could also post visible markers without waiting for basemap idle. Neither is in this repo, so neither belongs in this issue.

Verify

  • Fresh browser (no cache), world view, type abe → Isabelle Billerey – Jacques Lauber is listed, with no panning needed.
  • gothru → the no-match message.
  • Clear the box → the list goes back to photographers in view.
  • Typing fast (i, is, isa…) never shows an older query's results.
  • City landing pages (/find-google-trusted-photographers/<continent>/<country>/<city>) still open pre-filtered, and their list still follows the map.

QA Tester Summary - Issue #111: Find Photographers: list search only filters the map's visible set, and stays empty until the slow basemap loads

Status: Passed
Tested on: 2026-10-19
Suite: qa-testing/tests/specs/directory/map-list-search-issue-111.spec.ts
Env: http://localhost:3000 (Production Next.js runtime)
Assignee: @ekosy9

Executive Summary

Item Result
Feature Under Test Directory-wide photographer search from the Find Photographers map side list
Search Input UX Placeholder updated to "Search photographers by name…" with proper aria-label
Initial Loading Feedback Displays "Loading the map… Photographers in view appear once it loads. Search by name meanwhile." instead of premature "Pan the map" instruction
Debounced In-flight Stale Drop Debounce 300ms + request ID counter invalidation dropping stale responses
Query Merge & Resilience Merges in-view matches with directory-wide /v2/photographers/users results; gracefully handles backend outage (Search failed)
Responsiveness Verified at 375px mobile viewport with responsive tab switcher (List / Map)
Test Coverage White Box, Gray Box, Black Box, Negative & Stress Testing
Final Verdict Passed

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification

  • Directory-Wide Querying via getPhotographersV2: In src/components/map-page.tsx, typing into the side list input triggers handleListSearchChange(value). It initiates a 300ms debounced call to getPhotographersV2({ search: q, size: 100, role: ROLE_PHOTOGRAPHER_360 }).
  • Race Condition Prevention: Tracked via searchReq.current = ++searchReq.current. Any subsequent keystroke invalidates older requests in flight, ensuring only the latest query result is populated.
  • Empty & Failed State UI Improvements:
    • Before the basemap tiles finish and post MAP_PHOTOGRAPHERS_MARKERS_VISIBLE, the UI informs the user that the map is loading while search by name is already active.
    • For non-matching queries, the UI renders No photographers named “<query>” along with guidance: Looking for a place? Use “Find a specific location”.
    • If the backend search fails or is unreachable, it surfaces Search failed - Try again in a moment. instead of crashing.
  • Live Coverage Pill Decoupling: The "photographers visible" counter and view-level indicators now accurately reflect inViewList from the map, decoupled from the active search input query results.

3 Black Box Verify race condition handling under rapid typing (i, is, isa…) and mobile layout responsiveness No stale query override, mobile viewports cleanly switch between List and Map without breakage Rapid keystrokes handled cleanly; 375px mobile view switches and displays list search TP ✅ Pass
